findings.title: Stop validation is bypassed at the main queue boundary and validation failures can escape preservation handling
evidence: A sole stop already present at its ordinal reaches the old direct main-loop branch. A wrong runId is ignored and stopPreserveLatest executes; optional fields and regular-file checks are likewise not applied there.

O_NOFOLLOW/ownership/size/drift errors thrown by readQueuedPreservingStop occur before preserveStopRequested=true. The generic active-batch catch can swallow them and continue, and preservation/fallback-Save guards do not receive the intended terminal flag.
Malformed stop JSON such as [{"action":"stop-preserve-latest"},] returns null and remains unserviceable during a wait.
findings.requiredFix: Use one common validated consumption path for already-present main-loop and newly arriving active-wait controls. Set terminal preservation intent for unsafe/invalid stop validation before propagating errors; recognize and fail closed on malformed preserving requests. Preserve raw bytes/hash/current-run/ordinal evidence when safely readable; never dispatch a wrong-run or mixed request. Retain the pending-Save readback boundary and ordinary-command non-dispatch.

findings.title: Erosion proof accepts a replaced controller or changed native center
evidence: The private map stores the outer effect wrapper only. Replacing effect.erosion with a fresh cloned controller after onset passes all remaining64-turn checks and requireErosionEvidence(...,true).
Changing the finite native center.x after onset, while preserving effect id/x/z and countdown, also produces accepted retirement evidence. Native center is only target-checked at onset.
findings.requiredFix: Retain/check both the actual effect and actual controller identities. Require the actual controller center to stay equal to its observed authored onset center on each visit and at retirement. Keep all exported historical samples cloned finite scalars and actual zero-counter removal checks.

findings.title: Some typed objective waits still reset on unrelated world progress
evidence: Actual shaman-ready calls have no IDs. objectiveProgress falls through to progressKey with[], which includes every unit/building; moving an unrelated Yellow Brave changes the key while readiness is unchanged.
Named Temple/trainee training still includes all Blue unit IDs/kinds. An unrelated Blue Brave birth resets the progress key while the intended training state is unchanged.
findings.requiredFix: Provide objective-specific readiness/training keys or otherwise restrict fallback inputs to the actual objective. Keep Erosion’s correctly scoped retained lifecycle progress. Add negative controls for unrelated movement, births, combat and constructions for affected typed waits.
